lines.en: : Oh dear lord, it never ends.
: Oh, come on. Since when is it a crime to spend time with my favorite student?
: ‘Spending time’ together isn’t exactly the issue...
Once again, I find myself at the porn shop with Makoto. And once again, she is not happy to see me.
But I guess not many people would be happy to see their teacher at a porn shop.
Unless you're surveying my class.
If that's the case, probably half of them would.
But obviously, Makoto is not one of them.
: Hey...
: What? Why are you saying hey like that?
: Is there anything I can do to help increase business here?
: I've been coming here for a little while now and I've yet to actually see any other customers.
: And I can't imagine the lack of men has been doing any favors for your family financially.
: I think you'd be surprised at how little of our sales historically come from men to begin with.
: There are a surprising amount of women willing to pay top-dollar for some of the items we have for sale here. Men are stubborn and just...use their hands.
: Which isn't to say that women don't use their hands, but...wait, why am I even telling you this?
: Because I expressed genuine concern for increasing your profits?
: Your genuine concern sounds more along the lines of a convenient excuse to spend more time somewhere I very obviously don't want you spending time in.
: And honestly, I think I'd rather go out of business than work in a porn shop with my teacher.
: Yeah, I can only imagine how much better it is to work in one with your family instead.
: Please die.
: I’d just hate to see all of your hard work go to waste, you know?
: Well, I don’t know if I’d call this hard work when I spend most of the night just standing around.
: Sure, we’ll still get a few actual customers each night, but most of them are just in and out in a few minutes.
: Well, I mean...do you expect them to hang around and have dinner here or something?
: Of course not. But people don’t even ask to use the back room anymore.
: When my dad was still around, his friends would practically swarm the place on weekends.
: Wait, back room? What back room?
: W-Wait! Did I say back room? Because I meant to say...bathroom!
: My dad's friends used to come here and use the bathroom all the time!
: Liar. Men aren't like women. We can go to the bathroom ourselves.
: That's....Shut up! No back room exists! Not in this store! Nope!
: It's too late, Makoto. I know it exists now.
: The bathroom? Of course it exists! And you’re welcome to use it if you'd like! Just let me get you the key and-
: Makoto. I need to see it.
: Ugh, great...
: Judging by how hesitant you are to show me, I'm going to assume it's pretty intense, isn't it?
: It's not that it's intense, it's just...
: The atmosphere is, uhh...much different. And my mom insists on having something constantly playing on the TV in there in case someone shows up.
: You mean to tell me that I can just come here and watch porn whenever I like without paying for it? And you've been keeping that a secret from me?
: Isn’t it more comfortable watching that kind of stuff in your own house?!
: I don’t want to have to sit out here while you're in there doing god-knows-what to yourself!
: That's an easy problem to solve. Just come in with me.
: A-Absolutely not! Me being in there with you would make this entire situation significantly worse!
: Worse? Or better?
: Worse!
: Compelling argument. But I think I have something that could persuade you otherwise.
: What could you possibly have that could-
I take out my phone and quickly flash my wallpaper to Makoto.
: You fucking perverted heathen! Why is that still there?! What use can you possibly have for a photo like that?!
: Oh, I have plenty of use for it.
: I've actually been thinking of getting it professionally printed and framed so-
: Ahhh!! Shut up, shut up, shut up! I’ll come with you to the stupid room! But if you so much as try anything, I'm never letting you inside again!
: Deal. Lead the way to paradise, Makoto.
: It's not-
: ...Fuck!
Makoto storms off toward the side of the room and moves aside a shelf full of vintage DVDs, revealing a secret passageway to a room in which I will shortly be watching porn with her.
Is this how I expected my night to go? Not exactly.
But the possibility was always there.
I just figured it would stay buried in the back of my mind for a little while longer...
Makoto and I pass through a narrow passageway into a room that completely contradicts the rundown aura of the front of the shop.
It looks strikingly clean and freshly renovated, which is actually the last thing I would have expected from a secret sex room in a porn store.
But I guess with barely any couples left in Kumon-mi, there isn't much secret sex to be had in the first place.
: Okay...here we are.
: You can take it from here, right? I’ll just get back to work and-
: What size frame do you think I should get for your dildo picture? I'm thinking of hanging it over the desk in my office.
: Ugh! Why did it have to be porn?! Why couldn't my family own a candy shop or a diner or something?!
Makoto begrudgingly stomps over to a couch in the middle of the room and sits down, quickly pulling her knees up to her chest and wrapping her arms around them.
I sit down beside her, taking note of how rightfully-guarded she appears, before directing my attention to the screen above us.
: Yeah, I don't like this at all.
: I think it's a great bonding experience for the two of us.
: You do realize there are plenty of ways for us to bond without watching strangers have sex, right?
: Oh, I know! Let's go study. Studying sounds fun, doesn't it?
: As fun as watching porn in a secret sex room? Not really.
: It's not a secret sex room! It's a viewing room where men, women, and couples can sample videos before purchasing them!
: Right. So you let couples in here under the pretense of them...what? Critiquing pornography and keeping their hands to themselves?
: I don't let anyone in here! I already told you this room has become essentially defunct with the disappearance of men.
: But didn't you say it was popular among your dad and his friends before that?
: Yes, but they were all men! And I refuse to believe that they were doing that sort of thing with one another!
: Hey, anything is possible in a secret sex room.
: It's not a secret sex room, damn it!
The girl on the screen above us is being relentlessly pounded from behind as the sounds of skin slapping echo throughout the secret sex room.
Her eyes roll to the back of her head as her legs appear to grow weak, but the man attacking her slit is able to stabilize her waist with his hands, pulling her further into him repeatedly.
He gets more aggressive the longer the two of them go on, and Makoto's level of discomfort seems to increase along with that.
She squirms in her seat, pulling her legs in tighter each time the girl lets out a high pitched moan.
: He’s...really going at her...isn’t he?
: He certainly is.
: He kind of looks like you...a little...
: I guess this is penance for my repeated viewing of your doppleganger's many orgasms in the Student Council Punishment Games DVD I borrowed.
: You didn't borrow anything. I bought that with my own money and it is my most regretful purchase to this day.
: Also, how many times did you watch that DVD? I can't imagine it stayed...umm...interesting after the first few viewings...
: More times than I can recall. Are you the type to get bored of things quickly, Makoto?
: Makoto?
: Huh? Oh. Sorry.
: I...uhh...I don't know...
: I suppose I have...certain things I prefer watching over others...
: Like what?
: Just...the normal stuff, I guess...
: What's normal is different for everyone, though. For example, the video we're watching right now seems like pretty standard hardcore porn. But some people are into the softer stuff.
: I'm...not really in the mood to be lectured on the pornographic viewing habits of different types of people, Sensei...
: Oh. So you'd rather sit in silence and watch that girl get her brains fucked out than actually talk? Fine by me.
: I'd...rather just get back to work. This is extremely uncomfortable and inappropriate.
: That's what makes it exciting, though. Right?
: There's hardly anything exciting about watching some guy who looks vaguely like you put his...really big penis inside of...some random girl...
: Even if...it looks as if she's about to climax any minute now...
I let the silence do its job and lull Makoto into a slightly-false state of security as I contemplate whether or not I want to try pushing my luck in here.
It's not enough simply knowing that she's getting turned on. I need her to actually want it and, right now, I can't tell if she does.
At the very least, I'm confident she doesn't actually want to leave. Especially now that she has her eyes glued to the screen.
: See? This isn't so bad, is it?
: It could...be a lot worse, I suppose...
: You're even more focused than me at this point.
: I'm just...
: I'm kind of shocked by how big that thing is...
: You're in for a pretty rude awakening in the future then.
: Huh? What do you mean?
: Just that it looks like a pretty average sized penis to me.
: That is average?...
: You work in the porn industry, how do you not know this?
: I don't know. I guess I've just...never paid close enough attention before.
: I have a very hard time believing that, Makoto.
: No, I really mean it. And it doesn't help that what I watch is typically...umm...less...zoomed in.
: A-ha. So you're more of a softcore person, aren't you?
: Shut up...I won't let you shame me into consuming the type of...aggressive...passionate...heated...material you're apparently so familiar with.
: I'm just saying that you should probably familiarize yourself with other types of porn if you're ever going to make your mother proud.
: I absolutely hate how accurate that suggestion was.
: So, when do I get to meet this mother of yours?
: Can you maybe...not ask things like that while the two of us are watching things like this?
: Besides, you've already met her. She’s a member of the Parent-Teacher Association.
: Oh.
: Uhh...right.
Welp, add one more thing to the list of what I should know but don’t on account of the whole reincarnation predicament.
I guess this means I can look forward to meeting Makoto's mom again, though.
Especially if she seems as...openly sexual as Makoto's made her out to be.
: So, umm...how long do you think this is going to go on for?...
: Could be anywhere from five minutes to a few hours. Depends on the type of film and how many actors are involved.
: I'm starting to feel like you might know even more about these types of films than I do.
: I'd be more surprised if I didn't. I like to think of myself as a bit of a connoisseur.
: That is extremely depressing and not something you should be sharing with anyone.
: Your mom wouldn't be happy to hear you say things like that, Makoto.
: Again, I am frustrated by how accurate that is.
Another several minutes pass by without much of a change to anything.
Well, anything other than my mindset, that is.
The fact that this has gone on as long as it has without any physical contact whatsoever is not surprising to me, given the circumstances, but obviously not what I'd consider ideal.
In an ideal world, Makoto's fingers would be curled around my cock as she experiences firsthand exactly what a true really big penis looks like.
In an ideal world, the bridge between teacher and student would have already burned down- and the two of us would be left stranded in the middle of the ocean with nothing to hold onto but each other.
I reach out to prevent myself from drowning.
: What's wrong?
: I guess nothing is wrong per se. This much is fine.
: It's just...well, we're obviously both feeling a...certain type of way...
: And I don't want this to be the first step toward something that...would not be okay.
: What about it wouldn't be okay, exactly?
: Uhh...the part where you're my teacher?
: And that you're twice my age?
: And that I'm on the clock?
: And that my mom could come back at any minute?
: Like I said, this much is fine, I just don't want it to lead to-
: This! This is exactly what I don't want it to lead to!
The current fights against me as I try to stay afloat the only way I know how.
: I told you before we came in here, didn't I? That I wouldn't tolerate you trying anything.
: But you like me, don't you?
: Why not act on that?
: Or, at the very least-
: Let me act on it.
: Why not act on it?...
: Isn't...Isn't it obvious?
: Because I'm scared...
: That's why.
: Scared of what? You see this sort of thing all the time. You imagine this sort of thing all the time.
: I do...yes...
: But that doesn't mean I'm okay with-
: With...
The current spits me back out onto the shoreline.
: Something came over me. I didn't mean anything by it.
: That...
: I guess I...did sort of expect that was going to happen...
: Otherwise, I wouldn't have tried to prevent you from doing it beforehand.
: Sensei...
: I really don't think it's healthy for our relationship that you keep coming here.
: It's only a matter of time until it starts spiraling out of control.
: And...I don't know if I'll be able to handle that.
: You can handle anything, Makoto.
: That's what I like about you.
: I can...handle anything?...
: That's right.
: There is no one in this world quite like you.
I force myself to leave before the tide comes in.
The last thing I hear is the sound of a stranger violently climaxing and a girl who I will unwillingly break breathing a sigh of relief.
I go to sleep with my face buried in the pillow.
Makoto’s affection has increased to [makoto_love]!
